{{Top|leg}}
'''Armor accessories''', also known as '''armor components''', were installed in [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for the purpose of increasing the armor's performance. The most common enhancements granted the wearer a number of resistances, however some improved the degree of armor flexibility or had the ability to speed the healing processes of the body. [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Robes]], such as worn by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], were rarely augmented, although certain enhancements, such as the [[environment underlay]] or the [[biorestorative underlay]] were adapted for use in robes.

In order to carry out the modifications, a workbench with adequate tools was required, in addition to armor and robes of high quality.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the games ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the armor upgrades had two varieties, underlays and overlays.
